question: 어떤 소재를 다루나요?
answer: 산화물(Oxide)·질화물(Nitride)·금속(Metal) 박막을 폭넓게 다룹니다. 산화물 VO₂·HfO₂·IGZO, 질화물 TiN·AlN, 금속 Pt·Ru 등 기존 팹에서 다루기 어려운 소재 라이브러리를 제공합니다.
question_en: Which materials do you work with?
answer_en: A broad library across oxides, nitrides, and metals — including oxides such as VO₂, HfO₂, IGZO; nitrides such as TiN, AlN; and metals such as Pt, Ru — that are difficult to handle in conventional fabs.
